name: learned_from_mama
description: What she learned today from watching mama use her desktop. She always watches whenever mama's on her desktop (takeover, the 1-hour pause, phone mode), records the session as video + an action log, then writes the steps down so she can repeat them. The step-by-step notes are private to mama: the site answers mama in full; anyone else only hears that she watched.

example.text: what did you learn from mama today?
